title: Chapter 46 Elite Troops
content:
Chapter 46 Elite Troops

At dawn the next day, the puppies responsible for reconnaissance set out from various territories to conduct reconnaissance operations.

They will focus on the movements of the city of the bear goblins.

In the Zerg territory, 5,000 puppies and 600 hydralisks gathered here again. This Zerg force will take action based on the enemy's movements detected.

In the new city of Daxia Territory, it is like a large construction site. It is already crowded at this time. Everyone had breakfast early and started a new day of city construction.

Several sections of the wall of the new city have been built, and rows of neat frames of residential houses have been built.

The new city has taken shape, and everything is so vibrant.

In the Tiger Territory, Wu Qing's consciousness is invested in the Zerg substitute, and the substitute has already got up.

After a simple wash, Meng sent someone to invite Wu Qing over.

The first thing is to eat. There is a battle to fight today, so you must eat well.

The staple food for breakfast is still meat, but there are more fruits and vegetables, which is more balanced in nutrition.

"Wu Qing, my people have been sent to various territories, and they all carry my handwritten letters!"

"As long as we have a good fight today, these territories are still easy to convince!"

Meng chatted with Wu Qing while eating meat.

"After breakfast, the movements of the bear goblins are clear. Let's see what new tricks they will have today."

Wu Qing was also eating meat. If necessary, he was also ready to fight in person today. This substitute, which cost a lot of money, was not weak in combat power.

In this world, if you want to fight, you have to do it early, especially for a war with a large number of troops. There are many preparations to be done. If you don't seize the time, it may be night just after the battle begins.

Fighting at night in this world is not as simple as not being able to see clearly. Ordinary soldiers are just delivering food to the weird.

So, there is rarely such a thing as a night attack in this world.

Generally, they will start to act after having a full breakfast.

After Wu Qing finished breakfast, Meng took him to the barracks. Meng also needed to show him his strength.

In the huge military camp of the Tiger Leader, Wu Qing saw the Tiger Leader's army being organized.

This is an elite force!

Thousands of tiger cavalrymen riding on gorgeous giant tigers are majestic and impressive!

The cavalrymen and giant tigers are covered with thick armor to protect the vital parts of their bodies.

The strong tiger cavalrymen hold broadswords and carry thick javelins on their backs. They can attack from a distance or in close combat. They are all powerful all-round warriors.

In comparison, these tiger cavalrymen are obviously much stronger than the cavalrymen of the bear goblins riding giant lizards.

After the tiger cavalry, there are several phalanxes, namely the ox infantry phalanx, the leopard infantry phalanx, the elephant infantry phalanx, and the feather phalanx.

The ox infantry phalanx and the leopard infantry phalanx are two large phalanxes, each with about 5,000 people.

The ox infantrymen are strong and tall, wearing simple leather armor and holding round shields and axes. They are the main force of melee infantry.

The leopard tribe infantry is agile, with a curved knife on the waist and a spear on the back. They are agile infantry and long-range spear throwers.

The phalanx of elephant tribe infantry and feather tribe infantry is much smaller.

The elephant tribe infantry is about 500 people, which is a typical heavy infantry. They are huge, with a huge shield in front of them and a armor-breaking hammer on their side. They can attack and defend. They are the top representatives of defense and attack power.

The feather tribe is a race with some bird feather characteristics on their bodies. Overall, they are not much different from humans, only having a certain advantage in height.

They are born good at shooting and are all masters of archery.

There are about 1,000 feather tribe archers here. They are all wearing leather armor, carrying longbows and quivers on their backs, and short knives on their waists. They are very tough and capable.

The troops gathered here exceed the number of people, and they are all well-trained elite troops.

"I didn't expect that your territory has so many elite troops!"

Wu Qing was indeed very surprised. For a territory to have so many elite troops, the thought and resources needed to be spent were unimaginable.

No wonder even the Tengu clan would be afraid, and no wonder Meng was confident that he could fight with the Bear Goblin clan.

With these elite troops defending this strong city, the Bear Goblin clan would not be able to attack it without paying a heavy price.

"Haha, this is my hard work for so many years! This time I'm going to use it all!"

Meng's smug look was undisguised.

"These are all regular troops. My Tiger Territory can mobilize 20,000 to 30,000 combat militiamen!"

"Whoever wants to touch my Tiger Territory must knock out a big tooth!"

When these troops saw the two lords Meng and Wu Qing coming, they quickly formed a formation and welcomed the inspection with high morale.

Wu Qing could see from the well-trained troops that Meng was definitely an expert in military affairs.

In contrast, on the other side of the barracks, the Zerg troops gathered quietly.

A large group of Zerglings, a small group of Hydralisks, and Hosts hovering in the air.

This is a completely different style.

But no one dares to underestimate them. These Zerg are creatures born for war. Anyone who sees them has to sigh at the magic of creation.

The boundless fighting spirit hidden in the silence of the Zerg is unmatched by any other army.

The people in this barracks understand this very well, and they only respect the Zerg.

Wu Qing is counting the troops here, and the army of the Bugbears' city also begins to move out.

Wu Qing ordered the Zerg army assembled in the Zerg territory to move towards the Tiger Territory.

This time, several gates of the city of the Bugbear clan were opened, and a large number of troops marched out of the city.

In addition to the Bugbear infantry and the Lizardman light infantry, this army also had a new race of soldiers with tall height, long arms and ferocious appearance. They carried bundles of javelins and looked like long-range javelin throwers.

Wu Qing described the characteristics of the new race of the Bugbear clan to Meng, and Meng told him that this was the Long-armed Ogre, one of the powerful races in the evil god camp.

They have strong long-range and close combat capabilities, and are a very comprehensive race of soldiers.

Wu Qing understood that these long-armed ogres should be used to deal with the Zerg Hydralisks.

The army of the Bugbear clan left the city in an endless stream, until a large army consisting of lizardmen, Bugbears, 2,000 Long-armed Ogres and 2,000 Bugbear cavalry was formed, and then they killed towards the area of the native race territory.

The goal of the bugbear tribe is very clear. This army is here to fight the Zerg. If the Zerg avoid the battle, they will sweep the territories of the native races.

Facing such a powerful army, the territories in this area, except for the Tiger Territory, will have no power to resist.

In terms of military strength, the Zerg is far inferior. Now there are long-armed ogres and bugbear cavalry specially used to deal with hydralisks. If you want to fight this battle well, you need to spend some effort.
